privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This is a placeholder for the privacy policy of le-hoetel. Hotels collect a guest's name, phone and language with their consent. Optional details are kept only if the guest agrees. We never collect continuous location, ID numbers or payment cards. A guest can ask a hotel to export or delete their data at any time.
